title: Inter should rest five before Fiorentina — Gazzetta expects five changes
caption:
Inter host Fiorentina tomorrow and, per Gazzetta dello Sport, Chivu is weighing as many as five changes — Carlos Augusto in for Dimarco, Esposito back in attack, Provedel set for his first Inter appearance per Sky Sport Italia. The one change that isn't a choice: Inter confirmed Luis Henrique has a strained left adductor, with no return date.
